feeds.title: Elementary Nest Blog
feeds.description: Hey, teachers! I am Jessica Tobin from Elementary Nest. In 2009, I began my journey as an elementary teacher. I first started as a kindergarten teacher, but hopped around to 1st and 2nd grade. My goal with this website is to share teaching ideas that will strengthen your teaching and provide materials that will simplify your life.

feeds.title: Saddle Up for 2nd Grade Blog
feeds.description: Saddle Up for 2nd Grade is your one-stop shop for engaging and educational tips for 1st and 2nd-grade teachers. Explore their collection of helpful blog posts related to guided math and hands-on learning and browse our collection of research-based math curricula.

feeds.title: Teacher by the Beach
feeds.description: I am in my 15th year teaching, I have taught grades 1-5. I am back in 2nd grade this year after a few years in 1st grade, and I love it! I have my masters in Elementary Reading, and I am a National Board Certified Teacher.

feeds.title: Lucky Little Learners Blog
feeds.description: Elevate your 1st and 2nd grade classroom with essential teaching activities and ideas. Discover a supportive ally in Lucky Little Learners, dedicated to understanding educators' requirements and delivering the tools for confident and effective teaching.

feeds.title: What I Have Learned » Second Grade
feeds.description: Second grade is a year where students enhance their reading and writing skills, dive deeper into mathematical concepts, and explore more complex science and social studies topics. It's a time for fostering independence in learning, encouraging critical thinking, and nurturing a growing curiosity about the world. Second graders are guided to develop problem-solving skills and creativity as they become more confident learners and collaborators in a supportive classroom environment.

feeds.title: Learning at the Primary Pond Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Alison. I share ideas and tools to help K-2 teachers simplify their planning and create engaging literacy lessons. I believe that teachers should have access to materials that are both easy to use and written around best practices.

feeds.title: Teaching Second Grade Blog
feeds.description: The blog was created by a veteran educator with over 30 years in the classroom who holds a degree from Morehead State University. The site's mission is to simplify planning, reduce teacher-stress, reclaim weekends, and provide engaging, time-saving resources for second-grade teachers.

feeds.title: The Applicious Teacher Blog
feeds.description: The Applicious Teacher is a blog by Leigh Langton, an experienced Florida educator who shares creative, hands-on teaching ideas for 2nd grade. Her blog focuses on reading, writing, math, and classroom organization, offering practical lessons and tips to make learning engaging and easy to implement for young students.

feeds.title: Simply Skilled in Second Blog
feeds.description: Anna from Simply Skilled in Second! She has been a teacher for over 20 years and most of those years have been in the primary grades.

feeds.title: Rockin' Teacher Materials
feeds.description: Hilary Lewis actively creates quality teaching materials for classroom use. Hilary Lewis is a 2nd grade teacher in Carmel, Indiana at College Wood Elementary.

feeds.title: Today in Second Grade
feeds.description: Just a little place where teachers can share ideas about education. Lots of freebies and fabulous ideas to implement in any classroom!

feeds.title: Sunny Days in Second Grade
feeds.description: I'm Denis, a veteran teacher determined to stay passionate about our profession. I teach, I create things to teach with, and then I blog about it.

feeds.title: Surfin' Through Second
feeds.description: A second grade teacher in Hawaii. Loves to surf and share about her adventures in the classroom and in the ocean.

feeds.title: Hippo Hooray for Second Grade!
feeds.description: Teaching tips, ideas, freebies, and resources for elementary teachers.

feeds.title: Smiling and Shining in Second Grade Blog
feeds.description: A second grade teaching blog with free math worksheets, grammar worksheets, and many more freebies.
